question: Which of the following persons' tenure was extended for one year as Chief of the Enforcement Directorate in November 2021?
solution:
The correct answer __**Sanjay Kumar Mishra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanjay Kumar Mishra:-**

 
 
• His tenure as Chief of the Enforcement Directorate was extended for one year in November 2021.
 
 
 
• **Enforcement Directorate:-**
 
 
• It is a law enforcement agency in India responsible for enforcing economic laws and fighting economic crime.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradyumna Sinha:-**

 
 
• He is a retired IAS officer who was appointed as the first Lieutenant Governor of Jammu and Kashmir after the state's special status was revoked in 2019.
